items.scene:
Narrator: One day, an old woman makes a gingerbread man cookie. She bakes it in the oven.

Old woman: It smells good! I'm hungry!

Narrator: The old woman opens the oven door. The gingerbread man jumps up and runs out the door!

Old woman and old man: Stop! Don't run away! We want to eat you!

Narrator: The old woman and old man chase the gingerbread man. He should run fast!

Gingerbread Man: Run, run as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!

Narrator: The gingerbread man sees a chicken in the yard.

Chicken: Stop! Don't run away! I want to eat you!

Narrator: The old woman, old man, and the chicken all chase the gingerbread man. But he's too fast.

Gingerbread Man: Run, run as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!

Narrator: He sees a cow in a grassy field.

Cow: Stop! Don't run away! I want to eat you!

Narrator: The old woman, old man, chicken, and the cow all chase the gingerbread man. But he's too fast.

Gingerbread Man: Run, run as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!

Narrator: He sees a horse next to a tree.

Horse: Stop! Don't run away! I want to eat you!

Narrator: The old woman, old man, chicken, cow, and the horse all chase the gingerbread man. But he's too fast.

Gingerbread Man: Run, run as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!

Narrator: The gingerbread man comes to a river. He should swim across it!

Gingerbread Man: Oh, no! I can't swim!

Narrator: The gingerbread man sees a fox. He shouldn't talk to the fox!

Fox: You really shouldn't stay here. I can help you. Climb on my nose and we can cross the river.

Gingerbread Man: OK!

Narrator: The gingerbread man jumps on the fox's nose. The fox throws the gingerbread man up in the air and ...

Fox: Yum! Delicious!

Narrator: And that's the end of the gingerbread man!
